CHEM

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows marked hypoxemia, mild leukopenia, neutropenia, thrombocytopenia, and elevated basophils. Creatinine is slightly elevated, suggesting possible renal impairment. Other parameters, including red cell indices, liver enzymes, and electrolytes, are within normal limits. The findings may indicate bone marrow suppression or systemic illness with hypoxemia and possible renal involvement; clinical correlation and further investigation are recommended.
